header.question: What are you going to sell today?

step1.title: 1. Set up store
step1.desc: Give a name & short description. So people immediately know what you sell.

step2.title: 2. Upload product
step2.desc: Insert image, price & details. Save, product instantly goes to the list.

step3.title: 3. Share product link
step3.desc: Copy the link, put it in your bio / social media posts. Let everyone know and get interested.
